outcome.playableLoop: title -> observe -> identity -> guard tutorial -> warden -> name resolution -> rumor preview -> departure -> success
outcome.technology: Three.js 0.180.0 + React Three Fiber 9.3.0 + React 19.1.1 + Vite

verification.result: 2 files, 9 rule and character-contract tests passed
2/2 Chromium tests passed serially: character lab and full captain route
PASS after removing one unused type import

browserEvidence.manual: Codex in-app browser completed the captain route and visibly reached DEMO COMPLETE.

performanceSnapshot.warning: Vite reports a JavaScript chunk above 500 kB. The previsual gallery contains five 2.0-2.7 MB PNGs. This is acceptable for Gate 2 evidence but fails a release-candidate performance bar until code-splitting and AVIF/WebP derivatives are added.

rootCauseIteration.issue: Parry and enemy impact were initially resolved by competing browser timers, producing load-dependent misses in automation.
rootCauseIteration.minimalChange: During a visible cyan telegraph, parry input is now resolved immediately by the deterministic reducer; ring dodge uses the same rule. Timers remain presentation-only.
rootCauseIteration.before: Manual timing could pass while headless runs intermittently missed and failed.
rootCauseIteration.after: Reducer tests pass and the complete Chromium route passes once with state-transition assertions.

preCommitAudit.issue: The character lab route was not integrated, graphical tests competed for WebGL resources, and screenshots used repository-root paths from a game-package working directory.
preCommitAudit.evidence: The first fresh E2E run failed to find the lab heading; parallel combat missed a telegraph; successful runs created a duplicated nested games directory.
preCommitAudit.rootCause: Late integration omitted the App route, Playwright used two workers for GPU-heavy pages, and screenshot paths assumed the wrong current working directory.
preCommitAudit.minimalChange: Wire the query route, reserve a unique E2E port, run one worker, skip redundant actionability delay only after cues are visible, and make screenshot paths game-relative.
preCommitAudit.verification: Fresh Playwright run: 2/2 passed in 22.8 seconds; both PNGs exist in indexed run directories; malformed nested directory removed.

knownLimits: Procedural hero, oath-warden, harbor and boat are detailed graybox code models, not production topology, UV, rig, collision or LOD assets.
The generated storyboard visually reads as a previsual beat sheet rather than a locked eight-panel final storyboard; it must be redrawn after Gate 3.
Only the captain route is automated end-to-end; pilgrim mechanics and all three rumor branches are covered at reducer level but need separate browser paths.
No production audio, controller mapping, touch controls or mobile performance validation yet.
No public deployment was performed; the current playable URL is local.
